title: Almost all finite groups are $2$-groups of class two
summary: We prove that almost all finite groups are $2$-groups of nilpotency class two, when groups of order at most $x$ are counted up to isomorphism and $x\to\infty$. More precisely, uniformly for $2^m\leq x 0$. For each fixed prime $p$, we give a formula for the number of groups of order $p^m$, with relative error $O(p^{-m/3})$ as $m\to\infty$. This refines the classical logarithmic estimates for the number of $p$-groups.
